title: LT2: Linear-Time Looped Transformers
author: Chunyuan Deng; Yizhe Zhang; Rui-Jie Zhu; Yuanyuan Xu; Jiarui Liu; T. S. Eugene Ng; Hanjie Chen
summary: LT2 introduces linear-time looped transformers that use efficient attention to reduce computation and memory costs. These models keep strong performance while running faster than traditional full-attention transformers. LT2 shows how mixing different attention types helps make deep, recursive models practical for future language tasks.
